title: Drop 54.4 deg C in 24h
summary: In 1972, Loma, Montana recorded a world-record 24-hour temperature drop from 12.2 deg C to -42.2 deg C.

title: Surge 27 deg C in 2 Mins
summary: In 1943, Spearfish, South Dakota experienced a rapid temperature rise from -20 deg C to +7 deg C in just two minutes.

title: Year Without a Summer
summary: Mount Tambora eruption caused severe global climate abnormalities, bringing frost and snow to North America in July.

title: Peak Heat: 56.7 deg C
summary: Death Valley recorded the highest ambient air temperature on Earth, establishing an extreme boundary of global climate.
